description: What the chat shows of Claude's artifacts (pages published on claude.ai): the Artifact tool's card with a "Published <title> ↗ v2" line, and artifact links in replies read as their titles. Every artifact is also listed on the side panel's Artifacts page.
opens: An Artifact tool call whose result says "Published <file> at https://claude.ai/artifact/…"
An artifact link in a reply
A Claude Desktop transcript's frame-link record

parts.name: publish card
parts.shows: A normal tool card (ToolCall) named "Artifact" with its description as the summary. Right under its header line, always visible: "Published " then the artifact's title as a link followed by ↗, then dimmed (55%) "v<version>" when the result gives one. The title is: the call's title, else the published HTML file's <title> (or a Markdown file's first # heading), else its file name humanized and capitalized (ops_dashboard.html → "Ops dashboard"), else "Artifact". Link tooltip: its URL.

actions.does: Opens the artifact in the browser.

parts.name: link in a reply
parts.shows: Inline at text size: the title the chat knows for that URL (from a publish), else "Claude artifact", followed by ↗, as a link (tooltip the URL). Updates to the real title once a publish names it. Recorded on the side panel's Artifacts list.

parts.name: from history
parts.shows: A Claude Desktop session's record of an artifact it published (with no Artifact call drawn): a quiet small dimmed line "Published <title> ↗".

parts.name: side panel row
parts.shows: ArtifactChip — [icon by kind] Title / claude.ai/artifact/… · v2, Open and Copy link — is on the side panel's Artifacts page, not in the transcript (see Artifacts.panel).

states.name: no publish in result
states.shows: Just a normal Artifact tool card; no Published line.
